definitions.launched: Reached live: status Live now, or Inactive with a record that it was live before. Development and pre-release projects have not launched.
definitions.liveOnStrongEvidence: Status Live where the status rests on the product itself (repo activity, on-chain activity, a product integration, a package release or a human check), not on its website answering or on the team's own announcement.
definitions.observedActive: A commit in a linked repo within 180 days of the snapshot, or a mainnet deployment observed through on-chain activity.
definitions.noActivityData: Launched, with no linked repo commit and no on-chain deployment record: alive or not, we cannot observe it.

onchainUse.note: Ledgers with an event between two weekly on-chain readings, per project. A contract used only through sub-calls emits no event, so 'no event or movement seen' is not 'not used'. 'could not check' until a project has two readings at least six days apart, and for good on a project with a contract whose ledger count the index never reports (it can show use, never its absence).
